business_requirement.text: i want to reset the password

epics.title: Password Reset
epics.description: Allow users to reset their password

user_stories.title: Password Reset
user_stories.story: As a user, I want to reset my password, so that I can regain access to my account.

acceptance_criteria.given: The user cannot access their account because they have forgotten their password
acceptance_criteria.when: The user initiates a password reset process
acceptance_criteria.then: The user is able to define a new password and subsequently log in with the new password

test_cases.title: Successful password reset and login
test_cases.precondition: User is unable to access their account because they have forgotten the password.
steps: User initiates the password reset process.
System allows the user to define a new password.
User enters and confirms a new password.
User attempts to log in using the newly defined password.
test_cases.expected_result: User successfully defines a new password and logs in with it, regaining access to the account.
